title: Topological-numerical analysis of global dynamics in the discrete-time two-gene Andrecut-Kauffman model
summary: We conduct a topological--numerical analysis of global dynamics in a discrete-time two-gene Andrecut--Kauffman model. This model describes gene expression regulation through nonlinear interactions. We use a numerical method to construct Morse decomposition of the system across a wide range of parameters at a fixed finite resolution in the state space and in the parameter space, both spaces split into uniform rectangular grids (a technique also called "pixelation").
